News & Articles

City of Louisville Declares March 19: Lady Falcons Day!

  • March 3, 2024

Louisville Mayor Craig Greenberg joined our community in celebration of the Simmons College of Kentucky Lady Falcons National Championship victory by declaring March 19th as Lady Falcons Day! The press conference was held at the new Alberta O. Jones Park. Let’s continue to point the spotlight on our Lady Falcons as they continue to bask in the glory of this historic win.
